title: Playing melodies on bass and tuba as a big trumpet
summary: Mingus studied a couple of years before going to classical teachers; Callender says he played melodies on bass and thinks of the tuba as a big trumpet.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: How long did he study with you?

Oh, I guess a couple of years or so, and then he went on to Rheinschagen(?) and the more Classical-versed teachers, those who didn't know anything about Jazz. But I gave him an approach to Jazz. He used to hear me playing, like, "Body and Soul" and just melodies... You know, I'd play melodies on the bass. This was before I had
met Blanton also that I was doing this. People used to say, "Hey, what's he doing? You're not supposed to do that on the bass." But that's the way I felt, and still do. Bass is just another...
...melodic musical instrument. And that's the way I feel about the tuba. As far as I'm concerned, it's a big trumpet.
Well, it has the same facility. It just takes a little more time to develop some chops for it.
That's why I can say there's never any time I don't have anything to do!
